verdicts.finding: WORK, not a meaning question. frozen.ts freezes the whole judgment folder `design/judgment/<context>/<cut>/` from `open` (contract F2). That is before any held-out check in it has been seen red. The freeze concept says each check is written before the build by someone other than the builders, and an example freezes only once its check has been seen to fail. The check-writer concept says the same. So once a cut is opened, the delivered freeze blocks the check-writer from binding held-out examples. This cut did exactly that step itself: b50731f4 at 14:42 wrote design/judgment/*/meaning-roles/ after the open at 14:29. The next cut will be blocked at the same step. F3 (freeze a check once it is seen red) already does this correctly for visible checks. Fixing F2's folder scope is the lead's realization call. The examples cannot catch this, because each Given starts with the checks already seen red.

The journal on this branch records each one accepted, with the architect's reasons: entries 01M4PBY8Z89MYYA38YX9E58M6Z (0120), 01M4PBY925W82JET9Q2BA4V7JF (0121) and 01M4PFCNJP6PD4X2AM6R4VT447 (0122), committed in bd12d791 at 15:54 and 1964f899 at 16:55. The lead's own transcript shows only the decide calls, not the accepts. The ledger's whole-check records at 23:40Z and 00:01Z still say 'pending'. The remaining red needs two architect acts on frozen checks: 0121 on fixture.ts:205 and held-out check.ts:38, and 0122 on agents/24's scenario, which has no cut. Neither change has been made, and no builder can make them.

Is each open question rightly a meaning question? 0120: yes. Two accepted decisions conflicted on whether an act taken in the turn is the topic's action. That changes how 23, 18, 20-24 and 28 are read. It was settled as 0117 governs, and the build and text follow it ('acts already taken being outcomes, never actions'). 0121: rightly the architect's, as a check-ruling rather than a change of meaning. The examples fix 'refused before appending' and say nothing about the line's form, so the check binds something its example never fixed. With only that form relaxed, everything else holds (64/64 visible, 4/4 held-out). 0122: rightly the architect's, as the lead's meaning (works only within a cut) plus a check-ruling on agents/24's setup. The same setup gap exists in held-out agents/2 and agents/3.

The ledger has no `freeze` entry for meaning-roles, so `workPackage frozen` lists checks: [] for it. Its visible checks (packages/cli/test/meaning-roles/freeze/, architect/) are therefore not protected by the gate. f6c41a50 changed them mid-build without a ledger record. I verified it is semantics-preserving: every JSON file deep-equals its earlier version, and the TS changes are formatting only. The lead should record F3 for them.

Shell routes that change frozen paths without naming them pass the gate (observed in the scratch copy). `rm -rf design/examples` and `git checkout HEAD -- checks` were allowed, and `git stash` / `git restore .` are the same kind. Removing a cut's examples file through such a route unfreezes its concepts, because frozen concepts are read from the examples in the working tree. Both are two-step or incidental routes, so this is hardening, not a finding.

Ways to name CRATYLUS_AGENT indirectly pass the gate (observed): `V=CRATYLUS_; env ${V}AGENT=architect …` and `export "CRATYLUS""_AGENT=…"`. Writing a script that sets the variable, then running it, is the same. These are contrived evasions.
When `workPackage frozen` cannot be read, the gate lets the call through with a notice, and a frozen cut with no examples left makes `frozen` throw. Consider failing closed for frozen-path writes.
The frozen concept list is taken from example tags, so it includes a non-concept, 'agents/ordering: bottom-line-up-front'. A concept a cut realizes but its examples never tag is not frozen.

agents/28's batch on the round-3 wording (0d3269cb) failed one-next-action and support. Its only evidence on the final text is one smoke run. That is enough under 0088(3), but it is weak cover after a fresh failure.

The final role phrase 'the next work it recommends, as the lead taking it into realization' closely echoes visible agents/28 ('the lead take the cut into realization'). It can be derived from the lead concept and 0102, so it is borderline under 0103(2) rather than a breach.
